title: A beautiful puzzle that teaches us a lesson too :)
originalTitle: A beautiful puzzle that teaches us a lesson too :) #chess #chesspuzzle #chessnest
transcript: [Music] In chess and life, the path forward is not always going to be clear, but that does not mean that there isn't one. In this position, white can win despite the triple pawns on the edge of the board with the beautiful maneuver bishop C7 and bishop B6. Brilliant move, a bishop sacrifice, but not one that black can accept without losing the game right away. Because of that reason, black has to try and keep the bishops on the board. But the white king has other plans and he's asking the question, where is your black king going to go? Because if you don't do anything about it, I'm just going to walk across the board. So the black king has to keep an eye bishop. But now the white king keeps asking the question and keep following the same pattern until eventually the black bishop has to leave the diagonal and the white king is finally able to win the last pawn and the
